name: @railsignal/backend
description: RailSignal Fastify HTTP API and BullMQ worker host

scripts.prisma:prep-prod: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const file = 'prisma/schema.prisma'; const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync(file, content.replace(/provider\s*=\s*\"sqlite\"/, 'provider = \"postgresql\"'));"
